 NCAAB Arizona vs Cal Poly College Basketball Prediction, Odds, Picks, Best Bets for Nov. 5
 Data Skrive 17h Subscribe to our newsletter
 Subscribe I confirm I am 21+ years of age Link The Cal Poly Mustangs (1-0) battle the Arizona Wildcats (0-1) at McKale Center on November 5, 2026.
 Before you place your bet on this matchup at FanDuel Sportsbook, here are the NCAA basketball odds and spreads you need to know.
 Arizona vs. Cal Poly Game Info and Odds
 Game day: Thursday, November 5, 2026
 Game time: 10:30 p.m. ET
 TV channel: truTV
 Location: Tucson, Arizona
 Arena: McKale Center
 Before making a wager on Thursday's Arizona-Cal Poly spread (Arizona -30.5) or total (173.5 points), read the betting insights and trends below.
 Sign up for FanDuel Sportsbook and FanDuel Daily Fantasy today! 
 Arizona vs. Cal Poly: ATS Betting Stats and Trends
 Arizona won 24 games against the spread last season, while failing to cover 15 times.
 Cal Poly won 17 games against the spread last year, while failing to cover 13 times.
 The Wildcats did a better job covering the spread at home (9-8-0) last season than they did in road tilts (5-5-0).
 The Mustangs' winning percentage against the spread at home last season was .583 (7-5-0). Away, it was .529 (9-7-0).
 Arizona vs. Cal Poly Head-to-Head Comparison
 Last season, Arizona was 12th-best in the nation offensively (86.2 points scored per game) and ranked 60th defensively (69.4 points conceded).
 Arizona was the second-best squad in the country in rebounds per game (39.9) and 25th-best in rebounds conceded (28.1) last year.
 Last season Arizona was ranked 43rd in the country in assists with 16.4 per game.
 Arizona committed 10.5 turnovers per game last season and forced 11.5 per game, ranking 138th and 136th, respectively, in college basketball.
 Cal Poly's defensive performance was -2-worst in the nation last season with 85 points allowed per contest, but offensively it played better, averaging 82.1 points per game (47th-ranked in college basketball).
 With 33.8 boards per game, Cal Poly ranked 85th in the nation. It gave up 33.4 rebounds per contest, which ranked 315th in college basketball.
 Cal Poly delivered 13.6 assists per game, which ranked them 192nd in the country.
 Cal Poly committed 14.7 turnovers per game (-5-worst in college basketball), and forced 12 turnovers per game (92nd-ranked).
